pages.title: Ephemeral Monopole Ore
pages.text: A vein that points only one way. Each fleck carries a lone magnetic pole, north without south or the reverse, which classical electromagnetism forbids. A compass held close swings and holds, refusing to recover.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Dirac showed one monopole anywhere would explain why charge is quantised. In foam substrate my compass locked onto a single seam and would not let go: monopole pairs, flickering up from the vacuum.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Quantum Foam (mine it for its drop).
